bullets.title: When Breath Becomes Air
bullets.creator: Paul Kalanithi
bullets.note: . This extraordinary book was recommended to me by various friends for years. I had it on my Audible app but never got around to listening, putting it off out of a perceived heaviness. I’m so glad and grateful that one close friend pushed me to finally absorb this beautiful book. _When Breath Becomes Air_ was a #1 _New York Times_ bestseller and a Pulitzer Prize finalist. From the description: “At the age of thirty-six, on the verge of completing a decade’s worth of training as a neurosurgeon, Paul Kalanithi was diagnosed with stage IV lung cancer. … Paul died in March 2015, while working on this book, yet his words live on as a guide and a gift to us all.”
